title: Beyond Leaderboard Ranks: Selecting Software Engineering Agents Under Budget Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.21515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Teams that adopt LLM agents for issue resolution must decide which agent to pay for, and how much to spend finding out. Leaderboard ranks give weak evidence for this decision. Accuracy differences may be statistically unresolved, reported costs may be inconsistent, and evaluating candidate agents can itself be expensive. We investigate budget-constrained agent selection using 58,197 run--task records extracted from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL), focusing on SWE-bench and six additional benchmarks.   Across seven benchmarks, 27 of 35 steps along the accuracy--cost Pareto frontiers are statistically unresolved. On SWE-bench, a run costing $34.16 trails the $170.78 leader by 14.6 percentage points, but the available tasks cannot statistically distinguish their accuracy. Reported costs also differ from standardized token-based estimates by up to 11.7x, while selective task evaluation can bias estimates of full-benchmark execution cost

translated_title: 超越排行榜排名：预算约束下的软件工程智能体选择
translated_abstract: 采用LLM智能体进行问题解决的团队必须决定为哪个智能体付费，以及要花多少钱去弄清楚这个问题。排行榜排名为这一决策提供的证据很薄弱：准确率差异可能在统计上无法确定，报告的成本可能不一致，而评估候选智能体本身也可能代价高昂。我们利用从全面智能体排行榜（Holistic Agent Leaderboard, HAL）中提取的58,197条运行-任务记录，研究预算约束下的智能体选择问题，重点关注SWE-bench及另外六个基准测试。研究结果表明：在七个基准测试中，准确率-成本帕累托前沿上的35个步骤中有27个在统计上无法区分；在SWE-bench上，一次成本为34.16美元的运行比170.78美元的领先者低14.6个百分点，但现有任务无法在统计上区分二者的准确率；此外，报告的成本与标准化的基于token的估计相差高达11.7倍，而选择性任务评估可能会使全基准执行成本的估计产生偏差。
tldr: 该研究通过分析58,197条运行记录发现，排行榜排名无法可靠指导软件工程智能体的选择——在七个基准测试的准确率-成本帕累托前沿上，超过三分之二的步骤在统计上无法区分，且报告成本与标准化token估计可相差高达11.7倍。
